title: Knife-edge EU Council methane vote could hinge on commission action plan
lede: EU member states remain split between a one-year and a three-year delay of the bloc's methane rules, with some saying that a commission action plan could tip the balance.

title: How the rescue of 28 people from a makeshift dinghy in a stormy Mediterranean unfolded – exposing the lethal reality of EU border policy
lede: A small, homemade, dinghy hoped to escape the deadly EU-sponsored Libyan coastguard by making its way north during one of the stormiest season in the Mediterranean Sea. Their successful rescue by volunteers contrasts with the reception they received from Italian authorities, prior to even touching European land.
